title: Explore a technical collaboration
lead: Partnership discussions can begin with a specific question and the evidence needed to answer it.
description: The areas below are possible topics, not statements of active partnerships or commitments.

sections.title: Sensing experiments
paragraphs: A discussion might concern optical test design, calibration, packaging or requirements for a future intended use. Any study scope would need separate agreement.

sections.title: Design workflows
paragraphs: For AIFIELD, a useful conversation could compare a defined photonic design task with existing tools under documented conditions.

sections.title: Bring a question
paragraphs: Tell us the project and the technical problem. We can discuss whether the available work and next experiments fit a collaboration.
